title: Multi-Vehicle Crash Kills Two, Injures Many Across India and US
summary: A coach bus collided with a vehicle on the Long Island Expressway in Queens, New York, triggering a chain reaction involving four other vehicles. This incident occurred while another bus collision happened on the Yamuna Expressway in Mathura, India, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries.
summary_points: Two people were killed in a multi-vehicle crash on the Long Island Expressway in Queens, New York.
The coach bus collided with a vehicle, triggering a chain reaction involving four other vehicles.
Twenty others were injured in the incident.
This accident occurred while another bus collision happened on the Yamuna Expressway in Mathura, India.
Multiple fatalities and injuries were reported in both incidents.
title_hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वाहन दुर्घटना में दो लोग मारे गए, कई घायल हुए
summary_hi: लंबाई एक्सप्रेसवे क्वीन्स में एक बस ने एक वाहन से टकराया, जिससे चार अन्य वाहनों में शामिल होकर एक दुर्घटना की शृंखला उत्पन्न हुई। इस घटना के बीच दूसरी बस दुर्घटना हुई थी, जो यमुना एक्सप्रेसवे मथुरा में हुई, जिसमें कई लोग घायल हुए और मारे गए।
summary_points_hi: लंबाई एक्सप्रेसवे क्वीन्स में दो लोग मारे गए थे।

framing.center: Centrist coverage frames the story as a tragic incident with multiple fatalities and injuries, without explicitly linking it to broader policy discussions or international implications.
